recent_news.headline: Houston Southeast Wastewater Treatment Plant Improvements Nearing Spring 2026 Completion
recent_news.summary: Southeast WWTP expansion project undergoing final testing to expand capacity to 10.2 MGD. Project includes improvements to blowers, headworks, clarifiers, and aeration basins for compliance with environmental regulations.
